title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
🛢️ US-Iran escalation: US strikes Iranian launchers on Larak Is. (Aug 30) → Iran closes Strait of Hormuz, claims drone strike on UAE (intercepted). Major geopolitical flare-up.
🛢️ Oil (Brent) +5.6% to $93 — Hormuz closure risk driving energy spike; WTI ~$86.
🥇 Gold +2.27% to $4,521 — safe-haven reversal after Friday's Fed-driven drop.
📉 BTC +0.6% to ~$78,400; altcoins stable. No cycle-moving price triggers.
📅 No major US data today; ISM Mfg PMI due Tue Sep 1, NFP Fri Sep 4.
